$comment: Team-shared Claude Code settings for openclaw-nodedev. Personal overrides go in settings.local.json. validate-commit.sh scans staged files for secrets/JSON validity before `git commit`; validate-push.sh refuses force pushes. Both also run as git hooks (config/git-hooks via core.hooksPath, installed by `npm prepare`), so they hold for any tool, not only Claude Code. The deny list below makes validate-push.sh's refusal true at the permission layer too (prefix rules only: a force flag placed later in the command is caught by the hook).
